title: Children Swimming in Public Wading Pool, 1938 Fullerton Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
747 A
FADE PROOF
AUG 29 1938
Finished by B. D. WOOD
Fullerton, California
description: Seven young children wade up to their chests in a shallow outdoor park pool or municipal wading pond on a bright late summer day. With soaked hair and candid expressions, they look directly into the camera while cooling off. A park lawn and metal pipe fence line the background. Captured during the late Great Depression in Fullerton, California, this snapshot reflects typical American small-town community leisure, where local municipal facilities offered free recreation and relief during hot summer days.
